title: Duplicate submissions write one output directory concurrently and poison it
symptom: Two jobs (e.g. 1693231 and 1693233) run the same case simultaneously after a broken job-id extraction made the submitter think the first submission failed.
root_cause: Fragile shell parsing of the scheduler output plus no duplicate-job check before submission.
minimal_fix: Cancel all duplicates, clear the intermediate outputs (75G -> 294K observed), and resubmit once; OML's preflight duplicate check and immutable run directories exist for exactly this.
validation: A clean single-job rerun reproduces a consistent dataset.
avoid: Leaving one of the two jobs running 'to save time'; concurrent writers invalidate every downstream check.

parameters.rule: cancel duplicates, clear intermediates, resubmit once
